detail.longDescription: On 12 October, CI on my EKS reference platform aimed a tenant's Argo CD Application at kube-system. Argo CD did not refuse it. Now a team is one directory and one pull request behind two walls: an Argo CD project that allows only its namespace and listed kinds, and sync impersonation, so a wrong project still gets forbidden from the API server. No list of what is forbidden. https:// platformengineering.org/blog/o ne-pull-request-two-walls-onboarding-teams-shared-eks-platform # PlatformEngineering # Kubernetes # ArgoCD
